title: Actor
description: Who acts (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"). Operators are unrestricted (D31); supervisors act only under grants; system actors are adcd's own components. Tokens bound to an actor are secrets, stored hashed, never in this record.

declared_agent.description: A self-declared label (e.g. a harness name); audit only, never enforcement.

created_by.description: The actor that created this one; the first operator is created by the bootstrap secret, recorded as the system actor.
